'''Hal Hull''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the owner of [[Hal's Goods and Services]], a general store in [[Glare Peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trivar II/Legends|Trivar II]] and a sympathizer of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak" />
